verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication token, used through a touch, a PIN and standard protocols such as FIDO2, PIV and OpenPGP. A built-in AI assistant to delegate tasks to is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Yubico ships any AI assistant, so the axis does not become applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
